description: Starts authorization for a social network account. Get network_id and a supported account type from networks.list; network_type_id 0 means profile, 1 page and 2 group. The response contains an auth_link for the user to open and authorize Blog2Social. Pinterest is an exception: it requires a custom application (service_conditions_id) and does not return an auth_link.

language.description: Optional language for the authorization flow, for example en or de.

network_id.description: Social media network ID returned by the networks.list tool.

service_conditions_id.description: Optional service conditions ID for using a custom application.

name: connections.add

auth_link.description: Authorization URL that must be opened to connect the account.

expired_in.description: Number of seconds until the authorization session expires.

session_token.description: Session token for the authorization process.

title: Start connecting a social account
